hook_text: R675 of bus money for 5 teams. One learner says R15 each. One glance says no.
clip_script: Sports day in Mthatha, R675 for 5 teams. Someone says R15 each. Stop. Estimate: 700 divided by 5 is 140, so each team gets about R140. Fifteen is missing a whole digit. Now do it properly. Break 675 into 500, 150 and 25. 500 divided by 5 is 100. 150 divided by 5 is 30. 25 divided by 5 is 5. Add them: R135 each. Now prove it by multiplying back: 5 times 135. 500 plus 150 plus 25. 675. True. Got a remainder? Multiply back and add it on. 255 books in stacks of 7: 36 remainder 3, and 7 times 36 plus 3 is 255. Estimate first, break it into friendly pieces, multiply back. Two techniques on every division and no wild answer survives.
visual_style: Whiteboard R675 splitting into three labelled piles; a wrong 15 crossed out next to an estimate of 140; a multiplication arrow looping back.
mood: Catching a slip in time, confident and quick.
pacing: The wrong answer caught by the estimate, the clean breakdown, the multiply-back proof, then the remainder case.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and divide the money in your piggy bank among four friends two ways.
